title: VoxelCore world generator
description: World generator config (<pack>/generators/<name>.toml, id pack:name), read by ContentLoader::loadGenerator. Biomes, structures, fragments and script.lua live in generators/<name>.files/.
markdownDescription: World generator config (`<pack>/generators/<name>.toml`, id `pack:name`), read by `ContentLoader::loadGenerator`. Biomes, structures, fragments and `script.lua` live in `generators/<name>.files/`.

caption.markdownDescription:
the generator display name. By default, it is generated from the id.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
caption.description: the generator display name. By default, it is generated from the id.

biome-parameters.markdownDescription:
the number of biome selection parameters (from 0 to 4). Default: 0.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
biome-parameters.description: the number of biome selection parameters (from 0 to 4). Default: 0.

sea-level.markdownDescription:
sea level (below this level, sea-layers will be generated instead of air). Default: 0.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
sea-level.description: sea level (below this level, sea-layers will be generated instead of air). Default: 0.

biome-bpd.markdownDescription:
Number of blocks per point of the biome selection parameter map.

Spelled `biome-bpd` by the engine (the docs say `biomes-bpd`, which is ignored).

Default: `4`.
biome-bpd.description:
Number of blocks per point of the biome selection parameter map.

Spelled biome-bpd by the engine (the docs say biomes-bpd, which is ignored).

Default: 4.

heights-bpd.markdownDescription:
number of blocks per point of the height map. Default: 4.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
heights-bpd.description: number of blocks per point of the height map. Default: 4.

heights-interpolation.markdownDescription:
Interpolation used to upscale the height map (`heights-bpd` > 1).

Default: `"linear"`.
heights-interpolation.description:
Interpolation used to upscale the height map (heights-bpd > 1).

Default: "linear".

biomes-interpolation.markdownDescription:
Interpolation used to upscale the biome parameter maps (`biome-bpd` > 1).

Default: `"linear"`.
biomes-interpolation.description:
Interpolation used to upscale the biome parameter maps (biome-bpd > 1).

Default: "linear".

wide-structs-chunks-radius.markdownDescription:
maximum radius for placing 'wide' structures, measured in chunks.

Default: `3`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
wide-structs-chunks-radius.description:
maximum radius for placing 'wide' structures, measured in chunks.

Default: 3.

heightmap-inputs.markdownDescription:
an array of parameter map numbers that will be passed by the inputs table to the height map generation function.

1-based indices; each must be `<= biome-parameters`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
heightmap-inputs.description:
an array of parameter map numbers that will be passed by the inputs table to the height map generation function.

1-based indices; each must be <= biome-parameters.

player-spawn-radius.markdownDescription:
radius of the player spawn zone.

Default: `100`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
player-spawn-radius.description:
radius of the player spawn zone.

Default: 100.

player-min-spawn-height.markdownDescription:
specifying the **preferred** vertical spawn zone.
Specifying a minimum height allows you to minimize the chance of spawning in underground voids, just as specifying a maximum allows you to minimize the chance of spawning on suspiciously dense cloud.

Default: `64`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
player-min-spawn-height.description:
specifying the preferred vertical spawn zone.
Specifying a minimum height allows you to minimize the chance of spawning in underground voids, just as specifying a maximum allows you to minimize the chance of spawning on suspiciously dense cloud.

Default: 64.

player-max-spawn-height.markdownDescription:
specifying the **preferred** vertical spawn zone.
Specifying a minimum height allows you to minimize the chance of spawning in underground voids, just as specifying a maximum allows you to minimize the chance of spawning on suspiciously dense cloud.

Default: `256`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#configuration-file)
player-max-spawn-height.description:
specifying the preferred vertical spawn zone.
Specifying a minimum height allows you to minimize the chance of spawning in underground voids, just as specifying a maximum allows you to minimize the chance of spawning on suspiciously dense cloud.

Default: 256.
